text:
alex: Heads-up — pushed a small prototype of a new ‘connection heuristics’ step for the Private setup wizard. It runs lightweight probes and surfaces likely fixes (firewall rule, DNS, MTU) with copy and a copyable curl/snippet. Want quick UX + a11y review before I ship the flag. Screenshot: https://corp-design/redwood/wizard-probe (mock)

maria: Nice. High level: I like the idea of surfacing likely causes instead of raw errors. Two UX questions: 1) do we show the probe results inline in the stepper or in a modal? 2) Where does the sample firewall snippet live — inline or a collapsible "how to" panel?

alex: Thinking inline but collapsed by default. Most users want a quick green/red + short reason; expand for details + sample commands. Keeps stepper compact. 

sam: inline collapsed sounds good. from infra POV: need to show how confident the heuristic is (low/med/high) — we can surface confidence as a small pill so users don't over-trust. Also add a hint about ephemeral probes (we don't attempt authenticated calls).

maria: Agree on confidence pill. Copy suggestion for the short reason: "Unable to reach metadata endpoint — likely firewall or routing. Expand for test details and suggested firewall rules." Short, active voice.

jia: Accessibility notes: 1) probe results must be announced via aria-live=polite when they appear; 2) the expand/collapse needs aria-expanded and descriptive aria-controls; 3) contrast for the confidence pill is low on the mock — bump to AA at least. Also ensure keyboard-only users can run the manual test button and get results without needing a mouse.

alex: Good call, I'll add aria-live and update contrast. For keyboard flow, we have a single `Run quick probe` button right under the step title. 

ollie: Docs note: please include copyable command examples for common edge cases: blocked outbound 443, NAT hairpin, and split-DNS. Offer both curl and a generic TCP test (nc). Example snippet for firewall rules we propose to show: ```
# allow outbound to metadata service
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -d 169.254.169.254 -j ACCEPT
```
Make sure we don't accidentally recommend iptables for systems where that's not applicable — add a short prefatory line: "Sample Linux iptables; adapt for your OS/firewall."

maria: UI microcopy: instead of "Run quick probe" maybe "Run connectivity test" — clearer for non-infra folks. Also change the expanded panel title from "Diagnostics" to "Suggested fixes & tests". Small wording reduces cognitive load.

sam: Another runtime note: probes should time out in 3s by default and we should show elapsed time. If network is flakey, tests can take longer; show a cancel button with keyboard focus.

jia: For screen reader users, the expanded panel should include a short summary sentence at the top (e.g., "Probe found port 443 blocked") before the detailed log output. Also ensure the log output uses a preformatted region with role="log" so SRs can navigate.

alex: On analytics: thinking of A/B testing two layouts — A: stepper with inline results (current), B: stepper that redirects to a dedicated diagnostics page with richer logs and guided fixes. Would help us measure dropoff/resolve rate.

maria: I worry B might add friction for first-time users. If we A/B test, track time-to-resolve and whether they expand details or copy a snippet. Also capture whether they click "Request help" to open a support ticket.

ollie: On copy variants for the short reason line, propose two options to test: 1) "Connectivity test failed — likely firewall or DNS. Expand for fixes." 2) "We couldn't reach the service. Common causes: firewall, DNS, or routing. Expand for step-by-step fixes." Option 1 is shorter, option 2 is more explicit.

jia: Also run a small keyboard-only test internally: tab through the whole stepper, expand panel via Enter/Space, run probe, cancel. We should catch any unexpected focus traps.

sam: UX detail: show a subtle green check or red warning on the stepper badge itself after probe completes so users can scan the whole wizard quickly. For red, include a tooltip that says "probe failed — possible fixes" with a link to open expanded panel.

alex: Implementation plan: I'll update the mock: - inline collapsed panel - copy tweaks per maria/ollie - aria-live + aria-expanded + role adjustments per jia - confidence pill with AA contrast - show elapsed time + cancel button - show stepper badge state + tooltip

maria: One more micro-interaction: animate the probe state (dots -> spinner -> result) but keep reduced-motion preference respected. Small delight without motion fatigue.

alex: Good call. I'll add prefers-reduced-motion media query. I'll loop back with an updated screenshot and a short recording of keyboard flow. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: flag "conn-heuristics" deployed to staging at 1865432160 — use feature flag for testing.

sam: Quick follow-up: add telemetry events `diagnostics.run`, `diagnostics.copy_snippet`, `diagnostics.expand_details`, `diagnostics.request_support` so we can instrument the A/B.

ollie: I'll draft the help center article with the sample snippets and OS notes once UX is final. Will ping for copy proof.

maria: Approve to ship to staging once updated mock + a11y notes included. :eyes:

alex: Will do, thanks everyone.
